status: CONSTRUCTED CONFIRMATION MATERIAL. Written and committed BEFORE any change to source-prep.js made after the 24-case regression run, so the six known divergences can be confirmed or refuted on cases the fix was not tuned on. Expected outputs state what a correct checker should report. It is never a sealed holdout and never a real-world validation set.
separation: Independent of tests/engine-candidate/regression/ (24 cases) and tests/engine-candidate/corpus/v0.1.0/ (15 records). Every text is listed as development material in lib/engine-candidate/dev-material.js.
rule: The fix may be run against this set once. Remaining mismatches are reported as found and not tuned away on this set.
